_comment: The book routes to the shared `compsci` theme (autoTheme matches \bict\b), which
is right for the palette and layout but carries the subject name "Computer
Science". This manuscript is not Computer Science: its own title page reads
"INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY FORM 2", and it says ICT 121 times
against Computer Science twice. Without this the cover, title page and running
header all called the book Computer Science.
subject: Information and Communication Technology
